items.title: 61530_Roy Eldridge oral history interview
items.q: he turned out to be a great buddy of mine after he got out of the band.

ctx.x: Well, yeah. If they didn't get to make records or...
I think I've got some records of his that we made at my house on those acetates. Him and Shorty Sherock and myself. Tony's probably got all those things. Poor Tony, he's in bad shape now.
